rapport_notes: Extremely patient across a 20-minute call with a detail-heavy customer, answers every insurance and long-item question directly without getting flustered.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before I discuss the pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any concern about the moving process" — asked only after all logistics were confirmed
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer volunteered concerns (long furniture fitting the truck, insurance coverage options) and the rep answered each directly in a single pass rather than probing further with 'what else is on your mind' — real but shallow follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "based on the factors that I've gathered from you, I estimate this to finish in seven to eight hours" — reiterated when the customer pushed to book fewer hours

top_strength: Handles sustained price/time negotiation (customer trying to book 5-6 hours instead of the estimated 7-8) without caving or getting defensive, while being transparent about the risk of under-booking.
coaching_note: No On-Time Guarantee or Communication (Stage 2 takeaway) at all in a 20-minute call — with this much open engagement from the customer, there was ample room to earn the ask and it was never made.
